title: Protein powder: do you actually NEED it? 🥤
caption:
Whey is dried milk protein: food, not magic. What matters is your total protein for the day. If food gets you there, you don't need it. Do you use protein powder? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 2
